title: Damage Allowance Cap by FBN Enrollment Tenure
content:
The damage allowance cap on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-damage approval is the long-tenure damage cap of 1 unit for an enrollment active at least the long damage tenure of 24 whole months since its activation date, and the mid-tenure damage cap of 2 units for one active at least the mid damage tenure of 12 whole months but fewer than the long damage tenure of 24 whole months. An enrollment active fewer than 12 whole months is not covered by this schedule.

Tenure is counted in whole months from the activation date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

## Schedule

| Whole months active | Damage allowance cap |
|---|---|
| 0 to 11 | not set by this schedule |
| 12 to 23 | 2 units |
| 24 or more | 1 unit |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, handling date 3 February)

- Activated 3 February two years earlier: 24 whole months, cap 1 unit.
- Activated 4 February two years earlier: 23 whole months, cap 2 units.
- Activated 4 February one year earlier: 11 whole months, not set by this schedule.
